user.title: Connect to Nourish
user.description: Enable the Home Assistant API in Nourish under Settings > Third-party integrations, then paste the API token. The server URL must use HTTPS.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace Nourish API token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid token for the same Nourish account and server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Nourish
reconfigure.description: Enter a new token for the same Nourish account and server. Use a new integration entry to connect a different account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Nourish. Check the server, API availability, and rate limit.
error.invalid_auth: The API token is invalid or revoked.
error.invalid_response: Invalid HTTPS server URL or unexpected API data. Check the API schema.

abort.already_configured: This Nourish account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The token must belong to the original account and server.

init.title: Nourish polling
init.description: Choose an interval from 1 to 43200 minutes. After 30 days without a successful pull, Nourish automatically performs a fresh export.
